stock.description: Colour Life Services Group Co., Limited operates as an investment holding company, providing property management and integrated community services across the People's Republic of China via an online platform. The company's diverse service portfolio includes managing communities on both commission and lump-sum arrangements, offering pre-delivery services to property developers, and providing advisory support to regional property management enterprises. Furthermore, it delivers various value-added services, such as community leasing and sales, which predominantly involve online promotional activities and assistance with sales and rentals. The company also extends engineering services, encompassing equipment installation, maintenance, automation system enhancements, and energy-saving solutions. Founded in 2002 and headquartered in Shenzhen, PRC, Colour Life Services Group Co., Limited is a subsidiary of Fantasia Holdings Group Co., Limited.
